cultureFacts.body_en: It's not just a saying: the Milliarium Aureum in the Forum was the point from which all distances across the empire were measured. Roman roads covered around 400,000 km of the known world.

cultureFacts.title: Il cannone del Gianicolo spara ancora ogni giorno
cultureFacts.title_en: The Janiculum cannon still fires every day
cultureFacts.body: Dal 1847 un colpo di cannone sparato dal Gianicolo segna il mezzogiorno romano. Fu introdotto per sincronizzare le campane delle chiese e ancora oggi attira curiosi e residenti.
cultureFacts.body_en: Since 1847 a cannon shot from the Janiculum Hill has marked Roman noon. It was introduced to synchronise church bells and still draws locals and curious visitors every day.

fr.title: Le canon du Janicule tire encore chaque jour
fr.body: Depuis 1847, un coup de canon tiré depuis le Janicule marque le midi romain. Il fut introduit pour synchroniser les cloches des églises et attire encore aujourd'hui curieux et habitants.

cultureFacts.title: Roma è anche la capitale degli obelischi
cultureFacts.title_en: Rome is also the capital of obelisks
cultureFacts.body: Roma conserva più obelischi egizi antichi di qualunque altra città al mondo, compreso il Cairo. I papi li usarono per ridisegnare i grandi assi urbani della città barocca.
cultureFacts.body_en: Rome preserves more ancient Egyptian obelisks than any other city in the world, including Cairo. Popes used them to redraw the great urban axes of the Baroque city.

fr.title: Rome est aussi la capitale des obélisques
fr.body: Rome conserve plus d'obélisques égyptiens antiques que toute autre ville au monde, y compris Le Caire. Les papes les utilisèrent pour redessiner les grands axes urbains de la ville baroque.

neighborhoods.name: Trastevere
neighborhoods.description: Il quartiere più autentico e bohémien di Roma. Vicoli acciottolati, osterie storiche e una vivace vita notturna. Ideale per chi vuole vivere la Roma "vera" lontano dalle folle turistiche del centro.
neighborhoods.description_en: Rome's most authentic and bohemian neighborhood. Cobblestone alleys, historic trattorias and vibrant nightlife. Perfect for experiencing the "real" Rome away from tourist crowds.
neighborhoods.description_fr: Le quartier le plus authentique et bohème de Rome. Ruelles pavées, trattorias historiques et vie nocturne animée. Idéal pour vivre la "vraie" Rome loin des foules touristiques du centre.
